## apiome convert {#convert}

Convert a catalog item to OpenAPI (``POST .../convert``); print the fidelity summary + warning.

A commit (the default) creates a publishable Project/version from the converted OpenAPI document; ``--dry-run`` returns the fidelity report only. ``--projection-out`` additionally writes the machine-readable projection manifest (CPDO-1.3). Exits non-zero on a low-fidelity tier unless ``--force`` — a hint that the converted spec is substantially incomplete.

```text
apiome convert [OPTIONS] ARTIFACT
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ARTIFACT` | text | yes | Catalog item id (the non-OpenAPI import) to convert. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--to` | text | `openapi` |  | Conversion target (only 'openapi' today; the verb is target-generic). |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Preview only: return the fidelity report with no project created. |
| `--out` | text |  |  | Write the would-be OpenAPI document here (dry-run only; '-' for stdout). |
| `--projection-out` | text |  |  | Write the machine-readable projection manifest here ('-' for stdout): which source construct became which OpenAPI pointer, and why anything did not. |
| `--force` | flag |  |  | Do not exit non-zero on a low-fidelity result. |
| `--title` | text |  |  | Fallback API title, applied only if the source declares none. |
| `--api-version` | text |  |  | Fallback API version, applied only if the source declares none. |
| `--server` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Fallback server URL (repeatable), applied only if the source has none. |
